nora: CI started failing after we made the JS SDK ESM-only. Vitest errors: "Cannot use import statement outside a module" and "require() of ES Module not supported" when our legacy test helpers `require()` the SDK.
devon: is CI running Node 18? Node version differences are common. Also Vitest prebundles deps — try deps.inline for the package so the test runner transforms the SDK source.
lee: example config: 
```
// vitest.config.ts
export default defineConfig({
  test: { deps: { inline: ['@redwood/inference'] }, environment: 'node' }
})
```
lee: inline helped but then our vi.mock wasn't applied — real module ran before mock. vi.mock must be evaluated before any import. Put vi.mock at the very top of the test file or use a manual mock in __mocks__ and import that first.
sam: for Jest legacy tests, use ts-jest ESM preset: 
```
preset: 'ts-jest/presets/default-esm',
globals: { 'ts-jest': { useESM: true } },
extensionsToTreatAsEsm: ['.ts']
```
devon: CI flakes also showed ERR_PACKAGE_PATH_NOT_EXPORTED when tests deep-imported internal files. Workaround: in vitest resolve alias to package src so tests compile TS source instead of dist with exports map. Example: `alias: {'@redwood/inference': path.resolve(__dirname, '../packages/sdk/src')}`.
nora: aliasing per-package in CI is fiddly but doable. Any tips for edge runtime differences (fetch, streams) in Node 18 CI?
lee: add a setup file that polyfills fetch and ReadableStream before tests run: 
```
import 'node-fetch/polyfill'
import { ReadableStream } from 'web-streams-polyfill/ponyfill'
globalThis.ReadableStream = ReadableStream
```
and configure `test.setupFiles`. Ensure setup runs before importing modules that use fetch.
sam: typing pain: TS complains about default vs named export in mocks. Quick test fixes: `import * as SDK from '@redwood/inference'` or enable `esModuleInterop`/`allowSyntheticDefaultImports` in test tsconfig. Long-term: align index.d.ts with runtime exports.
devx-bot: Note: file a follow-up to add a CJS test target for SDK to help legacy consumers. See internal issue 412.
nora: actionable list: 1) add deps.inline for vitest 2) ensure mocks registered before imports 3) add polyfill setup for edge APIs in CI 4) consider source aliasing in CI 5) use ts-jest ESM preset for remaining Jest tests. I'll open a PR with snippets. Thanks! :thumbsup:
